PPA Jurisdiction. The Masa Port zone, as delineated, is hereby
placed under the administrative jurisdiction of the PA, which shall, consistent with the
regional industrial plans of the government, implement a program for the proper zoning,
planning, development and utilization of the port.

Repeal. All issuances, orders, rules and regulations, or parts
thereof, which are inconsistent with this Order are hereby repealed, amended or
modified accordingly.

Separability. If any provision of this Order is declared invalid or
unconstitutional, the other provisions not affected thereby shall remain valid and
subsisting.

Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 6th day of Dêcember, in the year of our
